newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end mixed, seen staying low.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end mixed, seen staying low.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed mixed on Monday as market liquidity tightened somewhat before Tuesday's payment deadline for T$35 billion in government bonds, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.996 percent against Saturday's 5.019 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.00-5.05 percent against 5.00. Dealers expected the rates to remain at the curret low level with payroll funds returning to the banking system.
In the bond market, the seven-year 86/3 bond yield was at 5.7350 against 5.7900. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
